code:
# Franka RAISED-stand SOURCE: picks a front cube -> delivers onto a RAISED handoff STAND (top z=0.95,
# cube rests z~0.975 = the UR10's proven pedestal-pick height) so a downstream UR10 receiver can relay it
# cross-Kit (the cont.229 handoff-height rule: UR10 can't reliably PICK a flat 0.775 cube, needs ~0.975).
# Same CP-01-proven Franka pick regime as CP-CHAIN-FRANKA-SRC; only the destination height changes.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Work table: half-extents [0.6,0.9,0.375], centre [0,0,0.375] -> TOP z=0.75; covers pick(+y), base, stand(-y).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[0.6, 0.9, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# CP-01-PROVEN orientation: +90deg about Z so base +X = world +Y; pick 0.40m in FRONT = reachable regime.
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

# ONE workpiece, 0.40m IN FRONT (local +y) under the PickSensor.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.80], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# RAISED handoff STAND BEHIND the robot (local -y = base -X, the CP-01-proven place side). Half-extents
# [0.10,0.10,0.075], centre z=0.875 -> TOP z=0.95 -> the relayed cube (size 0.05) rests at centre z~0.975.
# Top is WIDER (0.20) than the UR10 receiver pedestal (0.12) for gentle-place tolerance; only the cube
# CENTRE transfers as the handoff, so the receiver re-instantiates on its OWN pedestal regardless.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Stand", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.875], scale=[0.10, 0.10, 0.075])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Stand", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path=None,
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Stand",
    drop_target=[0.0, -0.4, 1.0],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Stand"],
)
